name: CSN 3102 乘客被热咖啡烫伤

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is China Southern 102, a flight from Guangzhou to Beijing, you are at gate 223, contact Guangzhou Ground and request push back and start up.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 China Southern 102，从广州飞往北京，在 223 号登机口，联系广州地面并请求推出和开车。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Ground, CSN3102, gate 223, request push back and start up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州地面，CSN3102，223 号登机口，请求推出和开车。

cards.audioText: C: China Southern 102, push back and start up approved, facing west.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 102，同意推出和开车，机头朝西。
cards.referenceText: Push back and start up approved, facing west, CSN3102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 同意推出和开车，机头朝西，CSN3102。

cards.audioText: C: China Southern 102, stand by, expect 30 minutes delay, lightning and thunder were reported in the vicinity of the airport.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 102，等待，因机场附近报告闪电和雷声，预计延误 30 分钟。
cards.referenceText: Roger, stand by, CSN3102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，等待，CSN3102。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have completed push back and start up, contact Ground and request taxi.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你已完成推出和开车，联系地面并请求滑行。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Ground, CSN3102, push back and start up completed, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州地面，CSN3102，推出和开车完成，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: C: China Southern 102, taxi via Juliet 1, Zulu to holding point runway 19.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 102，经 Juliet 1、Zulu 滑行至跑道 19 等待点。
cards.referenceText: Taxi via J1, Z to holding point runway 19, CSN3102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经 J1、Z 滑行至跑道 19 等待点，CSN3102。

cards.audioText: B: You are holding at holding point Foxtrot 1 runway 19, you are ready for departure, contact Guangzhou Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你在跑道 19 Foxtrot 1 等待点等待，准备好离场，联系广州塔台。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Tower, CSN3102, holding point F1 runway 19, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州塔台，CSN3102，跑道 19 F1 等待点，准备好离场。

cards.audioText: B: Weather forecast says the thunderstorm will not improve in about half an hour, you decide to taxi back to the apron for holding.
cards.audioTextZh: B：天气预报称雷暴约半小时内不会好转，你决定滑回机坪等待。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Tower, CSN3102, the thunderstorm will not improve in about half an hour, request taxi back to the apron for holding.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州塔台，CSN3102，雷暴约半小时内不会好转，请求滑回机坪等待。

cards.audioText: C: China Southern 102, line up and wait runway 19, expect 30 minutes delay.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 102，进入跑道 19 等待，预计延误 30 分钟。
cards.referenceText: Line up and wait runway 19, CSN3102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 进入跑道 19 等待，CSN3102。

cards.audioText: B: Thirty minutes later, the weather is improving, you observed a small cell 3 miles from runway 19, you ask to turn right heading 120 and climb to 900 meters to avoid it.
cards.audioTextZh: B：三十分钟后，天气正在好转，你观察到距跑道 19 三海里有小单体，申请右转航向 120 并爬升至 900 米以避开。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Tower, CSN3102, we observed a small cell 3 miles from runway 19, request turn right heading 120 and climb to 900 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州塔台，CSN3102，我们观察到距跑道 19 三海里有小单体，请求右转航向 120 并爬升至 900 米。

cards.audioText: C: China 7102, when airborne, turn right heading 120, climb to 900 meters, cleared for takeoff runway 19, contact Departure on 121.95.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China 7102，离地后右转航向 120，爬升至 900 米，跑道 19 可以起飞，联系离场 121.95。
cards.referenceText: When airborne, turn right heading 120, climb to 900 meters, cleared for takeoff runway 19, 121.95, CSN3102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 离地后右转航向 120，爬升至 900 米，跑道 19 可以起飞，121.95，CSN3102。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are airborne, passing 600 meters, contact Guangzhou Departure.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你已离地，正通过 600 米，联系广州离场。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Departure, CSN3102, airborne, passing 600 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州离场，CSN3102，已离地，通过 600 米。

cards.audioText: C: China Southern 102, Guangzhou Departure, radar contact, turn right heading 300, climb to 900 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 102，广州离场，雷达识别，右转航向 300，爬升至 900 米。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 300, climb to 900 meters, CSN3102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 300，爬升至 900 米，CSN3102。

cards.audioText: C: China Southern 102, climb to 3000 meters on standard.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 102，标准气压爬升至 3000 米。
cards.referenceText: Climb to 3000 meters on standard, CSN3102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 标准气压爬升至 3000 米，CSN3102。

cards.audioText: B: During climb, 1 of the passengers was scalded by hot coffee, contact Guangzhou Departure and request return to land.
cards.audioTextZh: B：爬升中，1 名旅客被热咖啡烫伤，联系广州离场并请求返回着陆。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Departure, CSN3102, 1 of the passengers was scalded by hot coffee, request return to land.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州离场，CSN3102，1 名旅客被热咖啡烫伤，请求返回着陆。

cards.audioText:
C: China Southern 102, what assistance do you need?
B: Tell the controller you need medical services upon landing.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：China Southern 102，你需要什么协助？
B：告诉管制员落地后你需要医疗服务。
cards.referenceText: Request medical services upon landing, CSN3102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求落地后医疗服务，CSN3102。

cards.audioText: C: China Southern 102, medical services will be ready upon landing.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 102，医疗服务将在落地后准备好。
cards.referenceText: Roger, thanks, CSN3102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，谢谢，CSN3102。

cards.audioText: C: China Southern 102, descend to 2100 meters, expect radar vector for ILS approach runway 19.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 102，下降至 2100 米，预计雷达引导 ILS 进近跑道 19。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 2100 meters, expect radar vector for ILS approach runway 19, CSN3102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降至 2100 米，预计雷达引导 ILS 进近跑道 19，CSN3102。

cards.audioText: C: China Southern 102, cleared for ILS approach runway 19, report established.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 102，许可 ILS 进近跑道 19，报告建立。
cards.referenceText: Cleared for ILS approach runway 19, report established, CSN3102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可 ILS 进近跑道 19，报告建立，CSN3102。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have established ILS approach runway 19, contact Guangzhou Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你已建立 ILS 进近跑道 19，联系广州塔台。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Tower, CSN3102, established ILS approach runway 19.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州塔台，CSN3102，已建立 ILS 进近跑道 19。

cards.audioText: B: Now you confirm if the medical service will be ready at the gate.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你确认医疗服务是否会在登机口准备好。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Tower, CSN3102, is medical service ready at the gate ?
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州塔台，CSN3102，医疗服务是否已在登机口准备好？

cards.audioText: C: China Southern 102, the ambulance and medical staff have been ready at the gate.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Southern 102，救护车和医护人员已在登机口准备好。
cards.referenceText: Roger, thanks, CSN3102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，谢谢，CSN3102。
